SRC-020:R1.text: Preserve the existing project-local .saipen/KNOWLEDGE authority: optional cards only; no new phase, STATE field, LOG taxonomy, database, daemon, network dependency, second state store, or mandatory full-tree cold load.

SRC-020:R10.text: Dogfood at most three strong existing repository lessons; report exact files, APIs, formats, digest, compatibility, retrieval and anti-bloat evidence, context/protocol size deltas, runtimes and limitations.

SRC-020:R2.text: Define a compact promotion gate requiring verified, reusable, decision-bearing, not cheaply derivable, non-duplicate, non-transient, safe knowledge; ordinary tickets default to zero and normally at most one card.

SRC-020:R3.text: Implement a stdlib-only structured card parser and validator for kind, scope, trigger, status, evidence, optional supersession linkage, title, concise claim and Why body, while legacy KNOWLEDGE files remain legal.

SRC-020:R4.text: Generate an explicit deterministic .saipen/KNOWLEDGE/INDEX.md projection with marker and content digest from card metadata and mechanically provable legacy path/title data; deletion must lose no authority and regeneration must restore exact bytes.

SRC-020:R5.text: Implement bounded retrieval from the current ticket or objective: use a fresh index when available, fall back safely to direct metadata discovery when stale or missing, return only the smallest relevant active card set, and never load all cards for an unrelated task.

SRC-020:R6.text: Expose retrieved lessons and their Why/evidence to the cold decision context so a materially affected discretionary decision can name its source without noisy read logging or hidden session memory.

SRC-020:R7.text: Support explicit supersession without deletion: only active cards participate in normal retrieval; validate safe existing non-self targets and structurally coherent replacement linkage without pretending to solve natural-language contradictions.

SRC-020:R8.text: Extend validator and CLEAN ownership for card/index structure and stale projection reporting while retaining existing leak/secret hygiene and never making ordinary continue a hidden writer.

SRC-020:R9.text: Add deterministic backward-compatibility, card, index, retrieval, promotion, security, context-size and behavioral tests proving a past lesson changes the bounded substrate supplied to a later cold decision.
